canonical_project: CtrlS Patna Edge DC 2 (Patliputra Industrial Area)
notes: CtrlS acquired land in the Patliputra Industrial Area (via BIADA) in Aug 2024 for a Rs 400 crore greenfield edge data centre with about 10 MW IT load and ~1,000 racks; the CtrlS official page now lists Patna Edge DC 2 at 11.6 MW IT load / 1,670 racks. Status marked planned as construction completion is not confirmed by public sources.
